title: Project Zero sets 90-day vulnerability disclosure, moving to 60 and 30
summary: Google&\#x27;s Project Zero announced that it will disclose vulnerabilities 90 days after reporting them to vendors under a policy it calls "Full 90," effective immediately. The team plans to shorten that window to 60 days on February 2, 2027, and to 30 days on January 3, 2028. The change applies to the security team&\#x27;s disclosure practice, not a new product, and compresses the time vendors and maintainers have to patch before details become public.
